description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the SABI (System ABI) configurations for different architectures and API versions, using Google Test framework. It includes predefined JSON strings for various architectures and a test case that checks if the current SABI matches one of the supported configurations.

classes.name: SabiTest
classes.description: Google Test fixture class for SABI verification tests.

methods.name: VerifySABI
methods.description: Test method that logs current API version and SABI, then verifies if the current SABI configuration is supported.
